AI document review measurement
Prepared by Dhruba Poudel

Status: no observed timing pairs recorded.

Use comparable source batches with the same document and line-item counts and equivalent complexity. Record manual entry, review and correction separately. For the capture workflow, include template/setup allocation, processing, review and correction. Record both active staff time and any material elapsed waiting time in notes. Reconcile outputs before accepting a pair.

Accepted pair: same source scope, equivalent review/correction coverage and reconciled output. A missing duration is blank, not zero. Keep customer names, financial amounts and source documents out of any public copy.

After collecting accepted pairs, compare total manual active time with total capture-assisted active time and report the sample size, workflow version and measurement period. Do not publish a percentage from this empty template or from fictional examples.
